summary: Replace the sync script with a setup command in the CLI
riskReason: Once remote.origin.push is set, plain git push pushes only the configured refspecs, so a wrong setup silently stops branches or plan refs from reaching GitHub.

rules.text: the refspecs come from the same prefix that ref and listIds use, so renaming the prefix changes setup too
setup configures fetch and push of plan refs and of refs/ldd/config (from #1's step 1.4), plus push of refs/heads/*, and running it twice adds nothing
plan refspecs have no +, so a ref that diverged on two Macs is rejected instead of overwritten
pushing and pulling are plain git push and git pull --ff-only

evidence: a test runs setup twice on a fresh clone and finds each refspec configured exactly once
after setup, git push sends branches, plan refs, and refs/ldd/config, and git fetch brings them all
